newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up, but off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up, but off early highs.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Thursday, but were off early highs as profit-taking by speculators trimmed early gains, dealers said.

"There was heavy buying because Nawaz Sharif has clear chances of winning the elections," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "But profit-taking in active scrips trimmed early gains. The index is likely to dip on profit-taking on Sunday."
The Karachi index rose 25.28 points or 1.67 percent, to end at 1,537.43 from 1,543.23 at noon. Gainers beat losers 212 to 33. PTCL rose 0.50 rupees to 33.30 and Hub Power 0.90 to 39.70.
Gainers led losers 213 to 34. Turnover rose to 43.74 million shares from 40.28 million on Wednesday.
Hub Power rose 0.90 to 39.70 rupees, PSO 3.25 to 287, PTCL 0.45 to 33.25 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.35 to 36.75.
